## Teaching Notes

Keep the modelling light. The main point is a reproducible workflow: validated data, explicit assumptions, grouped summaries, and readable code.

## Expected Summary Pattern

```{r}
#| eval: false
summarise_portfolio <- function(data, group_var) {
  data |>
    group_by({{ group_var }}) |>
    summarise(
      earned_premium = sum(earned_premium, na.rm = TRUE),
      claim_amount = sum(claim_amount, na.rm = TRUE),
      loss_ratio = claim_amount / earned_premium,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}
```
